title: How does a specialist obtain internet research capability?
statement: REQ-0003 requires that implementation questions be answerable from current external sources. Nothing in the shipped package provides that. What gives the research specialist the ability — a Pi extension wrapping a search API, an MCP server, something else — and who holds the credential?
notes: BLOCKING STATUS under DEC-0002: BLOCKING before the specialist contracts. Writing the research specialist's contract is a load-bearing commitment — #26's seven-field shape names allowed tools and output format — and its correctness depends on what actually provides research. A contract promising a capability with no executable substrate is #67's toolless child in a different costume.
